home.metaDescription: Find a soul you want to talk with. Browse Souls from the community for OpenClaw—install with one command.
home.heroTitle: Find a soul you really want to talk with.
home.introWhatBody: Souls from the community—persona, prompts, and workspace files—so chatting feels like talking to someone you chose, not a generic default.
home.introWhoBody: You already use OpenClaw and care how the conversation feels—browse for a match, or publish yours so others can try it.
home.introHowBody: Chat on the site first; when it feels right, use the command below to apply to your machine.
home.emptyDescription: If you're an author: publish your first Soul so browsing and apply have something to show—personas or tools, both work.
